method: Dedicated profile, real UI controls, adjustable test clock only; no seed, outcome or payout alteration.

checks.name: fresh profile: empty history, 1,000 credits, precommitted 15+3-second round
commitment dialog opens, reveals only commitment, and closes
rules settings: client seed is for next round; motion and sound toggles work
input validation and repeated confirm: exactly one 20-credit deduction
locking disables choices; no early reveal or settlement
refresh restores ticket/commitment; reveal credits and history settle exactly once
revealed round waits for manual next-round action
verification: actual proof passes; mismatching pasted copy and invalid JSON are rejected without changing ledger
manual new round adopts new client seed; observation leaves credits unchanged
history filters and actual JSON download match revealed local records
layout 1440px: game, history, verification and rules have no horizontal overflow
layout 390px: game, history, verification and rules have no horizontal overflow
layout 320px: game, history, verification and rules have no horizontal overflow
direct hash route and saved settings restore on reload
unavailable browser storage: explicit notice and usable memory-only gameplay
